info.title: API.SH: Kickstarter
info.description: The Kickstarter API from API.SH: public Kickstarter data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Kickstarter's categories and their subcategories: id (use as `category_id` in search), name, slug and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kickstarter-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A project's comments, newest first: id, text, date, author (name, profile slug, avatar), badges such as superbacker or creator, and up to 20 replies each; plus the total. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kickstarter-comments

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A kickstarter.com/projects/... link, its `creator/project` slug, or the numeric project id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Comments per page (default 25, max 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous answer to get the next page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A creator's profile (name, bio, avatar, location, websites, join date, backings, superbacker flag, launched projects) and the projects they created, 20 per page (name, link, state, blurb, backers, percent funded, goal, pledged, dates, image, category). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kickstarter-creator

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The creator's profile name (from kickstarter.com/profile/...), a profile or project link, or the numeric user id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous answer to get the next page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Kickstarter projects as the site's advanced discover page lists them, 12 per page, with all its filters: id, name, blurb, link, creator/project slug, state, staff pick, goal, pledged (own currency and USD), percent funded, backers, created / launched / deadline dates, country and location, category, creator, image and video. Plus the total. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (and `seed` with `sort=magic` to keep the same order); null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/kickstarter-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (optional; leave out to browse).

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Category id from /kickstarter/v1/categories, e.g. 34 (Tabletop Games).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Comma-separated: `live`, `successful`, `upcoming`, `late_pledge`, `failed`, `canceled`, `submitted`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default `magic`, the site's own mix).

parameters.name: staff_picks
parameters.description: `true`: projects Kickstarter loves only.

parameters.name: pledged
parameters.description: Amount pledged bracket, same steps as `goal` (0 to 4).

parameters.name: raised
parameters.description: Percent raised: 0 under 75%, 1 75-100%, 2 over 100%.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Location id (the site's `woe_id`), e.g. 2459115 for New York.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: The `seed` of the first page, so later pages of `sort=magic` keep the same order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
